objects.name: Detection technique coverage: disable-defender-mpengine-registry
objects.description: The following analytic detects the modification of the Windows Defender MpEngine registry value, specifically setting MpEnablePus to 0x00000000. This detection leverages endpoint registry logs, focusing on changes within the path "*\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\MpEngine*". This activity is significant as it indicates an attempt to disable key Windows Defender features, potentially allowing malware to evade detection.
